name: Champion · 出裝
note: Only 出裝's own content: the frame (splash, page hint) is the one on 概覽. The build in buying order on a fixed five-column grid (Zaviel 2026-11-03): every box has a fixed height and empty cells keep their place, so switching the play style (its words or a tap on the left or right side) moves nothing. Every item cell is alike: icon, name (two lines), what it is for. Without the Mayhem builds: counted sets, our builds and teammate builds. Captured from the app with Katarina (卡特蓮娜).
